name: agenticintegrationhub
description: Vendor-neutral guidance for enterprise agent integration, orchestration, MCP gateways, and routing.

interface.longDescription: Design, build, review, and troubleshoot enterprise agent integrations across business applications, APIs, events, and data platforms. Covers agent orchestration, agent and task routing, MCP clients and servers, MCP gateways, tool discovery and routing, identity, policy enforcement, recovery, and observability. Provides architecture diagrams, code examples, configuration guidance, and validation plans for developers and enterprise architects. Vendor-neutral: apply patterns to the platforms in your landscape, including cloud services, CRM, ERP, ITSM, and custom systems. This skills-only plugin does not itself host a gateway, connect to tenants, execute backend operations, or deploy integrations. It does not collect user information or log activity for the publisher; processing by your AI host and other services is separate. Independent project by Rameshkumar Varanganti at agenticintegrationhub.com; not affiliated with or endorsed by third-party vendors.
